profileLabel: CURRENT CAPS: $1,000 pair (OPERATOR-SUPPLIED, pending configuration readback), $50 ranged value (operator-supplied; $50 matches the live Uniswap vault's maxRangedValueUsd)

assumptions.gasSource: Uniswap vault keeper measured costs used as a PROXY (PR #13 evidence r3: $0.0663 per recenter, $0.5737/day hourly checkpoint cadence); not Ramses vault measurements
assumptions.reserveSource: ramses-vaults/README.md fixture value (20%); configuration, not decided
assumptions.protocolShare: 0.5 (fork-measured, fork-final.log) unless a run says histshare
assumptions.keeperLatency: baseline rows evaluate on every swap and oracle update (zero latency); *_poll300 rows look once per 300 s; transaction inclusion delay (a second or less on this L2) is not modelled; any faster-than-300 s keeper is hypothetical
assumptions.guard: max_stale 12 h; weekend and holiday sessions block recentering; 150 bp pool-vs-oracle allocation gate; per-recenter loss bound 10 bp
assumptions.unmodelled: dividends/uiMultiplier, _requireBandCoversGate, integer oracle tick, settlement swaps, borrow demand, RAM holder entitlement

runs.single600_trig300: BASELINE: +/-600 ticks (~6.2%), trigger 300 (the contract maximum for 600), 1 h cooldown, <=24/day
runs.single600_trig300_poll300: REALISTIC LATENCY: the keeper looks once per 300 s (the baseline rows react on every swap/oracle update, an idealised zero-latency upper bound)
runs.live1200_trig300_perday4: the live Uniswap vault's policy shape: +/-1200 ticks, trigger 300, at most 4 recenters per day
runs.single600_trig300_noreserve: sensitivity: reserve cut 0 (shows what the 20% reserve costs holders)
runs.single600_trig300_cap5k: sensitivity: maxRangedValueUsd = half of capital (rest stays idle)
runs.single600_trig300_histshare: sensitivity: historical protocol share (5% before 2026-09-30, then 50%)
runs.fee_fixed150: COMPARISON: the listed/instantaneous 150 ppm held constant instead of the fee actually in force
runs.fee_x15: STRESS: every swap's fee x1.5 (volume unchanged)
runs.fee_x2: STRESS: every swap's fee x2 (volume unchanged)
runs.fee_x3: STRESS: every swap's fee x3 (volume unchanged)
runs.full_range: full range (adapter default minUsableTick..maxUsableTick); no recentering
